herd_susceptibility.rationale: Acted against consensus repeatedly (coup of 18 Brumaire, self-coronation)

authority_compliance.rationale: Overthrew the Directory; ignored Senate; defined his own legitimacy

contrarian_tendency.rationale: Fought successive coalitions; defied European royal order

empathy.rationale: Famously cold toward battlefield casualties; abandoned his armies twice

financial_optimism.rationale: Confidence in conquest-funded treasury; Louisiana Purchase for quick cash

loss_aversion.rationale: Staked empire on single campaigns; chose risky escape from Elba

fomo_susceptibility.rationale: Driven by need for historical glory; envious of Alexander and Caesar

communication_assertiveness.rationale: Iconic proclamations and addresses; direct command style

persuasion_skill.rationale: Rallied exhausted troops at Lodi and Arcola; charmed diplomats and soldiers

information_sharing.rationale: Prolific writer/correspondent yet tightly controlled military intelligence

tradition_vs_progress.rationale: Modernizer of law, administration, education; metric and meritocratic reforms

individualism.rationale: 'Impossible is not French'; cult of personal destiny

spirituality.rationale: Pragmatic deist; Concordat with Rome was political, not devout

openness.rationale: Archetypal polymath; curiosity spanned painting, anatomy, engineering, botany, hydraulics

conscientiousness.rationale: Famously abandoned works (Adoration of the Magi, Battle of Anghiari); Mona Lisa unfinished for years

extraversion.rationale: Charming at Sforza and French courts; but workshop solitary and reserved

agreeableness.rationale: Described by contemporaries as gentle and generous with apprentices

neuroticism.rationale: Some melancholic notebook reflections on time and mortality

risk_appetite.rationale: Served rival patrons across Italy; pursued dangerous anatomical dissections

analytical_depth.rationale: Dissected 30+ corpses; invented scientific notation; reverse-engineered flight, hydraulics

impulsivity.rationale: Jumped between projects; but often deliberative on individual experiments

patience.rationale: Iterated obsessively on paintings yet abandoned many due to shifting interests

social_dominance.rationale: Respected court artist; commanded his studio; not politically dominant

herd_susceptibility.rationale: Challenged Aristotelian received wisdom; direct empirical observation over authority

authority_compliance.rationale: Served patrons but on his own terms and schedule

contrarian_tendency.rationale: Dissected corpses despite Church prohibition; wrote in mirror script; vegetarian in meat-eating age

empathy.rationale: Vegetarian on ethical grounds; bought caged birds to free them; anatomical studies with evident compassion

financial_optimism.rationale: Courted wealthy patrons continuously; confident in securing commissions

loss_aversion.rationale: Relatively stable patronage; but protected notebooks and unfinished works closely

fomo_susceptibility.rationale: Internally driven by curiosity rather than contemporary status competition

communication_assertiveness.rationale: Prolific in writing yet deliberately coded notebooks to obscure content

persuasion_skill.rationale: Secured patronage from Sforza, the French King, the Medici, Cesare Borgia successively

information_sharing.rationale: Mirror-script notebooks deliberately resistant to others; trade secrets protected

tradition_vs_progress.rationale: Epitome of progressive empirical thinking breaking from Scholastic tradition

individualism.rationale: Uniquely polymathic approach; refused guild and academy constraints

spirituality.rationale: Religious commissions executed; notebook content heterodox and proto-deist
